end.summary: Discussed language, food, dress and festival diversity across India.
end.parentNote: Riya practised examples of regional diversity and the idea of shared threads beneath different traditions. They used school languages and festivals such as Pongal and Bihu, and identified common agricultural and seasonal ideas, including links to the sun’s movement. At first, they treated “shared thread” as festivals simply happening in the same season; this was refined later in the lesson. At home, ask Riya to explain one shared value found in two different festivals.
